unavailable: We could not reach the analytics service, so this tab is empty. That is a fact about the service, not about this group — nothing here has been lost.

state.noContent: The course has none of this

summary.notJudgeableHint: A verdict needs about {threshold} weighted samples. Below that the profile refuses to judge, and these cells are hatched rather than scored.

chart.title: Delivered against absorbed
chart.qualityStrip: Quality of what was attempted, per unit — hatched where nothing was attempted
chart.noTimetable: We could not ask the timetable, so no unit is marked as taught or untaught. Lessons may well have been held.

unit.lessons: {count, plural, =0 {no lessons} one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}
unit.spread: {median}% median, {p25}–{p75}% across {n, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}
unit.unlinked: Taught, but this plan unit has no course unit behind it, so nothing it covered can be counted.
unit.insufficient: Only {learners, plural, one {# student has} other {# students have}} attempted it — under the threshold of {threshold}, so no verdict is shown.
unit.noContent: This unit has no items to complete.
unit.notStarted: Taught, but nobody has opened it yet.

context.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {no attempts} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
context.note: Where work happens has only been recorded since {from}; anything older sits in “Not recorded”. Classwork stays empty until attempts started in a lesson are marked as such.
context.unattributed: {count, plural, one {# attempt names} other {# attempts name}} no course at all and could not be placed in any bucket.

unlinked.title: {count, plural, one {# taught plan unit has} other {# taught plan units have}} no course unit behind them
unlinked.body: These lessons happened, and nothing they covered can be counted until the plan unit names a course unit.

noCourse.title: No course is attached to this group
noCourse.body: There is nothing to measure against until the group is teaching something.

noLessons.title: No lessons held yet
noLessons.body: Progress compares what was taught with what was taken away, and nothing has been taught yet.

noAttempts.body: {units, plural, =0 {Nothing taught yet} one {# unit taught} other {# units taught}}, nothing measured yet. Absorbed shows a dash, not a zero — nobody has attempted anything.

heatmap.title: Students × units
heatmap.subtitle: A median hides the person who is drowning. This does not.
heatmap.empty: Nobody is on this group's roster yet.
heatmap.unavailable: We could not load the per-student map. The chart above is unaffected.
heatmap.neverSeen: “Never seen” means nothing has been recorded for that learner at all — which is not the same as falling behind.

empty.title: Nothing measured for this student yet
empty.body: No attempt of theirs has reached the profile. The skill grid stays blank on purpose — an empty profile is not a weak one.

summary.ownNoScale: No group scale to read it against
summary.inGroupNoScale: Nobody in the group has been measured yet
summary.attemptsSub: {count, plural, one {# more attempt names} other {# more attempts name}} no course at all
summary.weakPairsSub: Skill × focus the profile has flagged

grid.title: Skill × focus
grid.subtitle: Colour is the weighted success rate. A verdict needs {threshold} weighted samples — below that the profile refuses to judge, and says so.
grid.note: An empty row is a fact about the course, not about this student: a channel the catalogue has no items for cannot be measured. Most work sits under “Not recorded” until the course says what each exercise trains.
grid.unclassified: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} could not be placed in the grid at all.
grid.coverageUnavailable: We could not ask the course what it teaches, so no cell claims the course has none of it.

forgets.label: Forgets fast
forgets.body: Right in the lesson, gone within days. Bring the review closer rather than teaching it again.

never-knew.label: Never learned
never-knew.body: Stable, and stably wrong — the wrong rule is what was learnt. Teach it again; more drilling will not help.

watch.label: Holding
watch.body: Within range, just slower than the group. Listed because something has to come first.

unknown.body: Weak, and nothing is recorded about how long it survives — nothing here tells forgetting apart from never having learnt it.

work.title: What to work on
work.subtitle: The same low score, opposite actions — the difference is stability.
work.empty: Nothing carries enough evidence to be called weak yet.
work.unavailable: We could not load the profile, so there is nothing to suggest. The grid beside it is unaffected.
work.samples: {count, plural, one {# weighted sample} other {# weighted samples}}

context.title: Where the work happens
context.subtitle: One bar, not a second chart.

position.title: Against the group
position.body: Absorbed {own}% against a group median of {median}%. {lower, plural, =0 {No classmate sits lower} one {# classmate sits lower} other {# classmates sit lower}}.
position.measured: {measured, plural, one {# classmate has} other {# classmates have}} a number of their own, this student included.
position.none: Nobody in this group has a number yet, so there is no scale to place this student on. That is not last place — it is no ranking at all.
